basic_info.description: Rare 5BD/3BA hillside home with Bay views, 2-car garage + 3-car driveway parking, and a terraced backyard ready for your vision. Bright living spaces, hardwood floors, and a renovated bath add as charm and function. The spacious unfinished basement offers endless possibilities — home theater, man cave, guest suite, creative space, or in-law potential. Enjoy a sunlit balcony and room to grow inside and out. A balanced San Francisco retreat with future potential.
